correctness.rationale: Exact face enumeration gives 16,80,144,72 nonempty simplices and no 5-faces. Chain compositions vanish; integer Smith factors have only one nonunit 2 in the top boundary, yielding H_2=Z^7 plus Z/2 and otherwise zero. Independent recursive generation, mod-two ranks and signed facet adjacency produce a second torsion proof. Directed 2- and 4-cycle closures establish unique unstable module from Definition 4.2(b). Two programs and their actual outputs are included.
